name: Matrix Determinant Obfuscation
description: Replaced the polynomial perfect-square check with a 2x2 matrix determinant check. The matrix [s_u, s_u^2; s_v, s_v^2] has determinant s_u*s_v*(s_v - s_u), which is non-zero if and only if s_u != s_v. This forces the models to either algebraically simplify the determinant or write a matrix evaluation function, disrupting their pattern matching for 3-coloring while remaining mathematically identical.
